LAW AND MOTION 301, PETITIONER MATTHEW POULIOT'S PETITION TO CONFIRM ARBITRATION AWARD IS GRANTED. THE PETITIONER PROVIDED THE COURT AT THE HEARING WITH A VALID PROOF OF SERVICE INDICATIVE OF STATUTORILY SUFFICIENT NOTICE AND SERVICE. NO OPPOSITION WAS FILED.
